fields.help_en: The list of filter values. Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh: 过滤器值列表。N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The filter name. You can specify one or more names for the query. Valid values:

SkillSpaceId: the SkillSpace ID. Exact match.

SkillSpaceName: the SkillSpace name.

MatchType: the match type that controls the matching behavior of SkillSpace. Valid values: exact, prefix, and fuzzy
fields.help_zh:
过滤器名称，可选择一个或者多个名称进行查询。取值范围：

SkillSpaceId：SkillSpaceId，精确匹配。

SkillSpaceName：SkillSpace 名称。

MatchType：匹配类型，控制 SkillSpace 的匹配类型，取值 exact(精确)/prefix(前缀)/fuzzy(模糊)
fields.name: name

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that was returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的行数。每页最大100行，默认为20行
parameters.name: max_results
